questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond-shaped warning sign alerts drivers that a traffic signal is coming up. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round signs with yellow and black markings warn of upcoming railroad crossings only.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downgrade is ahead. Check your brakes before descending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red eight-sided sign means you must stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a two-way road with traffic in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Only proceed when it is safe. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection so you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show the direction of a sharp curve in the road. The arrow points the direction the road curves. You may see several chevron signs placed throughout a curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped and yellow with black lettering or symbols. They alert drivers about hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns that traffic signals are at the intersection coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings tells drivers that one of the lanes ahead will end. Traffic must move left to merge with other lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to conditions ahead. This sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location. It is unlawful and unsafe to make a left turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to conditions ahead. This sign tells drivers that an intersection is coming up so they can prepare for traffic or turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns drivers about school zones. It tells drivers that children or other pedestrians may be crossing in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that the road ahead has limited overhead space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow sign means you are near a school. Watch carefully and be ready to stop if you see children in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to places where animals, pedestrians, or other traffic may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An orange reflective triangle on a vehicle means it travels very slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, road work vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. During the day it looks like a solid orange triangle. At night it looks like a hollow red triangle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign appears with a traffic signal. It tells drivers turning left on green that they must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road curves right first, then curves left. Slow down to safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a divided highway is starting. Keep to the right of the center divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade or hill ahead. It may be very long, have sharp curves, or be difficult to drive.
